signOut.title: Sign Claude Desktop out?
signOut.body: Claudepot will quit Claude Desktop and delete the live session items. The current snapshot is preserved, so you can swap this account back in later.
signOut.bullet1: Any unsent Desktop chat drafts will be lost.
signOut.bullet2: Next Desktop launch will open to the login screen until you sign in again.

overwrite.title: Replace Desktop profile for {{email}}?
overwrite.body: <emph>{{email}}</emph> already has a stored Desktop snapshot. Binding the live session will overwrite it with the current state.
overwrite.note: The previous snapshot is stashed to a temporary directory during the copy; if the new snapshot fails, the old one is rolled back. On success, the old snapshot is permanently discarded.

splitBrain.title: Claude Code is running
splitBrain.intro: A running Claude Code session is using the current account. Until you quit it you'll see split-brain state:
splitBrain.bullet1: Session identity (header, org name) stays as the old account — cached at startup.
splitBrain.bullet2: API calls (/usage, completions, billing) switch to <emph>{{email}}</emph> immediately.
splitBrain.bullet3: The next OAuth refresh (typically within the hour) may overwrite the keychain back to the old account, silently reverting this swap.
splitBrain.note: Safest: quit Claude Code first, then swap. This action proceeds with <c>{{flag}}</c>.
